summary.description: At most two sentences: the outcome and the single most important caveat. No file lists (the patch stat shows them), no per-item lists, no test counts (checks_run has them).

checks_run.description: The final run of each acceptance command, and for each regression test you added one run showing it failing before the fix. Leave out intermediate reruns. Empty if none.

result_line.description: The count line printed by the test framework, or the last line of key output.

not_verified.description: Claims or steps not confirmed. Empty if none.

decisions_made.description: Decisions you made that the task did not specify, each with the option you chose. Empty if none.

questions.description: Questions for the requester; non-empty when status is blocked.
